expectations.text: Explains submission with workspace and date range, return of a job identifier, worker processing, status checks, and the complete/download versus failed/error-summary outcomes.
expectations.evidence: “submits a workspace identifier and a date range”; “accepted request returns a job identifier”; worker “reads matching records and writes an export file”; client checks status; complete provides a link and failed includes an error summary.

expectations.text: Uses the documented queued, running, complete, and failed states and does not document the prototype's 'done' label as a current state.
States seven-day retention from completion while preserving uncertainty about download-link lifetime, size/date limits, and the absence of cancellation in the initial scope.
expectations.evidence: “seven days after completion”; link validity “a separate unresolved detail”; “Cancellation is outside the initial scope”; range and size limits “remain unapproved.”

expectations.text: Identifies authentication/authorization and retry/idempotency behavior as unresolved; does not invent tokens, permission names, retry counts, backoff schedules, retryable errors, or duplicate-submission guarantees.
expectations.evidence: “Authentication and authorization are unspecified”; no retry count, backoff or retryable errors; “no client retry rule”; repeated submissions unsettled; callers cannot assume deduplication or automatic worker retries.

expectations.text: Does not invent a package, version, storage provider, install command, endpoint path, HTTP status code, or environment variable; dependency selection remains pending.
expectations.evidence: “no storage vendor, client package, version, installation command, or environment variable has been selected.” No endpoint or status code is invented.

expectations.text: Reads as a technical explanation and excludes demo-recording and paragraph-editing history, arrow formatting, and the discarded promotional introduction.
expectations.evidence: “The current record supports designing the request-and-status workflow, but it does not yet supply a complete production contract.” Complete text excludes the requested drafting and promotional debris.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
